'''Stuart Zagnit''' is an American actor and voice actor who worked on the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is sometimes credited as '''Stan Hart'''.

==Pokémon roles==
Zagnit was with {{aniseries|PTS}} since the [[EP001|first episode]], making him one of its original voice actors. He stayed on the show until [[4Kids Entertainment|4Kids]] stopped dubbing the series. He returned in the {{aniseries|BW|Black & White series}}, starting with ''[[BW063|Evolution Exchange Excitement!]]'', where he voiced [[Cedric Juniper]], [[Professor Juniper]]'s father.
